newsitem.title: MEXICO: Telmex to pay 0.175 peso dividend per shr.
newsitem.headline: Telmex to pay 0.175 peso dividend per shr.

text.p: Telefonos de Mexico SA de CV (Telmex) will pay a dividend of 0.175 peso for each outstanding share from November 21, the company said in a report on Monday to the Mexican Stock Exchange (BMV).

Telmex said that, as agreed in a shareholders' meeting on April 19, 1996, payment would be made on presentation of coupon number zero and the simultaneous exchange of A series shares of 01 and subsequent coupons, for A shares currently in circulation.
Telmex added that the adjusted share prices for A and L shares after the dividend payment would be 12.385 and 12.365 pesos, respectively.
Telmex added that it adjusted share prices this morning in advance of the dividend payment to 12.385 on its A shares and to 12.365 pesos on its L shares.
The company typically adjusts its stock price lower when it pays a dividend. Telmex A shares closed on Friday at 12.56 pesos and its L shares were at 12.54.
Today both Telmex A shares and L traded off to 12.16 pesos, down 1.82 pct and 1.66 pct, respectively.
Telmex ADRs will receive the dividend based on their 20 L shares per ADR ratio.

Telmex also said that it would also exchange A series shares with 01 and subsequent coupons for crisp new A shares. The exchange is being done merely to replace old stock paper with new bills. Mexican shares ordinarily carry many coupon dates.
